headline: Get your homepage redesigned for free
subhead: See exactly how your homepage could look. A custom concept, delivered in 48 hours. Free, no strings attached.
trustLine: Free · No credit card · Yours to keep.

steps.title: Share your website
steps.body: Tell us what is not working and where the current site lets the business down.

steps.title: We audit and redesign
steps.body: We review the evidence, benchmark the category, and prepare a premium homepage direction.

steps.title: You review the concept
steps.body: See the work and decide whether you want to talk about what comes next.

faq.question: Why is the homepage redesign free?
faq.answer: We want you to judge the quality before deciding whether to hire us. The concept should be useful whether or not we work together.

faq.question: What exactly do I receive?
faq.answer: A human-reviewed homepage mockup, desktop and mobile direction, an evidence-based website audit, a category benchmark, and a clear explanation of what should change.

faq.question: Is this a template?
faq.answer: No. We use your real business information, brand, services, images, and category references. The concept receives a human design review before delivery.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: Our target is 48 hours after the request is accepted. Complicated sites or missing content may need more time; we will tell you rather than send weak work.

faq.question: What happens if I like the concept?
faq.answer: We can talk through the next step if the direction feels right. There is no pressure to continue, and the free concept is useful even if you decide not to work with us.

faq.question: What is included in the redesign?
faq.answer: A human-reviewed homepage direction, desktop and mobile thinking, an evidence-based audit, category references, and a clear explanation of what should improve.

faq.question: What happens with the rest of the website content?
faq.answer: If you continue with the website, we can carry over useful existing blog posts or create 8 original launch posts. That gives the site useful depth from day one and a stronger foundation for search, without promising rankings.

faq.question: Will the website rank on Google or AI search?
faq.answer: The build includes a sound technical, structured-data, content, and internal-linking foundation. No honest provider can guarantee rankings; ongoing authority and content work compound over time.

faq.question: Do I have to continue?
faq.answer: No. You may review the free concept and audit with no obligation to continue.

faq.question: What is the AI Smart Website?
faq.answer: It is our fast-launch package for new contractors, startups, and businesses testing a market. It is a focused website of fewer than five pages, built on a proven framework and prepared to go live within 24–72 hours.

faq.question: Does the AI Smart Website include AI chat?
faq.answer: Yes. The package is designed to include an AI-assisted chat path that answers common questions, captures contact details, and gives a customer a clear next step. The exact chat behavior is configured around your services, service area, and approved answers.

faq.question: How does lead capture work?
faq.answer: Every package is built around clear conversion paths such as click-to-call, contact forms, service-specific requests, and callback requests. The goal is to make it easy for a ready customer to start a conversation instead of searching through the site.

faq.question: What is the callback feature?
faq.answer: A callback path lets a visitor request contact when they are not ready to call immediately. The request can include their name, phone number, service need, and preferred timing so your team has useful context for the follow-up.

faq.question: Which package is right for my business?
faq.answer: Choose the AI Smart Website if you need a credible presence quickly. Choose the Simple Elite Website if you want a premium core site in one to two weeks. Choose the Ultimate Contractor Website if you need a deeper service, location, content, and market-coverage build.

faq.question: How quickly can the AI Smart Website go live?
faq.answer: The target delivery window is 24–72 hours after we receive the required business information, approvals, domain access, and content or proof needed for the launch. Missing access or late approvals can change the timeline.

faq.question: Is the AI Smart Website a template?
faq.answer: It uses a proven framework for speed, but it is configured around your trade, services, service area, brand, proof, contact details, and approved messaging. Speed comes from the system; relevance comes from the business information we put into it.

faq.question: Is a website alone the same as a lead machine?
faq.answer: No. A website is one part of the system. A lead machine combines the offer, local relevance, service pages, trust proof, fast mobile experience, AI chat or forms, callback paths, tracking, and follow-up so more of the right attention can become a conversation.

faq.question: Do you guarantee rankings, leads, or booked jobs?
faq.answer: No honest provider can guarantee rankings, lead volume, cost per lead, revenue, or closed jobs. We build a stronger technical and conversion foundation, explain the evidence behind the strategy, and make campaign targets depend on your market, offer, budget, and response process.

faq.question: What does the $797 website launch include?
faq.answer: The $797 flat launch includes the approved website build, conversion-focused homepage, service coverage, launch content, structured-data foundation, domain connection support, quality assurance, and the handoff needed to put the system live. The exact scope is confirmed before payment.

faq.question: Are hosting and advertising included in the website price?
faq.answer: The $797 price is for the website launch scope. Hosting, ongoing maintenance, and optional Meta ads management are separate when requested. Meta advertising spend is paid directly to Meta from your account.

faq.question: Do I own the website?
faq.answer: Yes. The completed website and approved business content are delivered for your company to use. Any hosting, software, third-party accounts, or ongoing support terms are explained separately so there are no hidden ownership assumptions.

faq.question: Can you work with my existing website and domain?
faq.answer: Yes. We can review an existing website, preserve useful content and proof, connect a domain you already own, or discuss a new domain when appropriate. Access requirements and DNS changes are confirmed before launch.

faq.question: Do you serve contractors outside one city or state?
faq.answer: Yes. We focus on US home-service businesses including electricians, plumbers, HVAC companies, roofers, remodelers, movers, restoration companies, and general contractors. The strategy changes with your trade, service area, competition, offer, and budget.

faq.question: What happens after I approve the build?
faq.answer: We confirm the scope, collect payment and any required access, complete the approved build, run quality assurance, connect the domain, and provide the launch or handoff steps. If you also choose marketing support, campaign setup and reporting are handled under a separate written scope.
